prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create one realistic high-fidelity desktop UI mockup for StoryDream Vox, dimensions 1536 x 1024. Current date 2026-10-22. The attached image is the CURRENT REAL APP screenshot: use its visual language and product content as grounding. Retain neutral dark Fluent styling: #101214 background, #1b1f23 surfaces, #f4f6f8 text, #b1b8be muted text, #f2614b coral action accent, restrained 6px radii and readable 14px Chinese UI. No browser frame, no dashboard charts, no gradients, no nested cards, no giant marketing heading.

Direction: a production outline with preview and in-context editing. Expert users can customize stages while novices keep automatic defaults. Show ONE canonical project, not competing novice and expert workspaces. A 56px app bar shows StoryDream and project title “城市为什么更热”, quiet saved state and “项目设置”. Left 240px is a vertical production outline with exactly four groups “文案”, “分镜”, “配音字幕”, “成片”. Expand “分镜” to reveal four simple compact shot rows with tiny realistic paper-collage thumbnails and names. Other groups are collapsed; small status text “自动” indicates default automation. No project/episode/shot duplicate hierarchy.

Main content fills the remaining width with NO permanent right sidebar. Top small breadcrumb “分镜 / 镜头 02” and a quiet “镜头设置” action. Main preview is a large 16:9 editorial collage with real photographic city towers, green trees, cut-paper orange sun, ripped paper textures and restrained halftone print. Title on video “城市为什么更热”. Under it minimal playback controls. Below playback, show a modest two-column inline edit strip, not cards: left “旁白” with two lines of plausible Chinese narration, right “画面描述” with two lines. Under edit strip a quiet “高级设置” collapsed disclosure and a neutral scoped button “重新生成此镜头”. These editable fields are local to the selected shot, not the whole project.

Bottom fixed full-width 76px PROJECT ACTION BAR outside all panes. Left summary “纸拼贴讲解 · 横屏 16:9 · 约 60 秒” and “自动完成所有未锁定步骤”. Right a quiet “查看制作计划” link and the single saturated coral button “一键生成成片”. Keep this bar visually stable regardless of the selected stage or shot. Do not add a second primary action, global effect picker, render engine selector, template library, code panel, seed field, generation queue, invented cost, or fake percentage. Clear hierarchy, generous spacing, clean alignment, realistic operational desktop UI.
